note: Synthetic workspace for retrieval and answer evaluation. Written by the project author; not drawn from real users. Pages intentionally contain distractors and two conflicting facts (pricing, sign-in).

pages.title: Authentication decisions
pages.markdown:
## Decisions

- 2026-03-03 (kickoff): Use magic-link sign-in for every account.
- 2026-04-12 (security review): Replace magic links with passkeys, keep email codes as a fallback.

The two entries disagree about the primary sign-in method. The April entry does not say it supersedes March.

pages.title: Billing plan
pages.markdown:
## Plans

The standard plan is 12 dollars per month, or 120 dollars billed yearly.

Invoices are issued on the first day of each month. Payments go through the payment provider configured for the account.

## Refunds

Refund requests are handled by the support team within five working days.

pages.title: Pricing experiment Q3
pages.markdown:
## Experiment

Draft test: a 9 dollar monthly price for new sign-ups in two regions.

Status: not approved. Billing plan still lists 12 dollars per month for everyone.

pages.title: Onboarding checklist
pages.markdown:
## Steps

- Create a workspace in a folder you choose.
- Load the sample project if you want examples.
- Set up a model for the assistant. This step is optional.
- Import a Markdown file to bring in existing notes.

pages.title: Offline sync research
pages.markdown:
## Requirements

Offline editing is required for the beta.

Sync between devices is out of scope until after launch. Two approaches were compared: operation logs and document snapshots. No decision on the approach yet.

pages.title: Hiring notes
pages.markdown:
## Candidates

The second-round interviews are scheduled for next Tuesday. Panel: two engineers and one designer.

Take-home exercise is limited to three hours.

pages.title: Search relevance experiments
pages.markdown:
## Results

Keyword search missed paraphrases such as biometric login for a fingerprint setting. Adding vector search improved the top-3 hit rate on the internal set.

We will keep keyword search as the fallback when the model is unavailable.

pages.title: Accessibility review
pages.markdown:
## Findings

All toolbar buttons need accessible names. Focus rings must be visible in dark mode.

Contrast of muted text is below the target in one theme. Fix before the release candidate.

pages.title: Release checklist
pages.markdown:
## Before the release

- Run the full test suite.
- Build the Windows installers.
- Verify a backup restore on a clean folder.

Installer signing: not configured. Say so in the release notes.
